confidence_notes: Searches covered the RBA rate and Kenting/Taiwan food and drink prices. Kenting-specific price data was thin and partly dated, so most food and drink anchors are based on Taiwan and Taipei aggregates adjusted for a tourist resort town. The wine-by-the-glass and cocktail anchors are inferred from the local beer price, because no direct glass-price data was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against listings. They are very uncertain because Kenting prices swing sharply between weekdays, weekends and peak season. The RBA rate is the 18 November 2026 observation, the latest found in search.
comparable_city_reasoning: Taiwan resort-town prices, based on Taipei and Taiwan aggregates plus Kenting reviews, adjusted slightly upward for tourist pricing. Hengchun and Kenting night-market and seafood-stall meals are cheap, but cafes, bars and hotels run higher.
